principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for both managing items and handling order status, while the PaymentProcessor class is responsible for processing payments. This mixes concerns, violating the SRP.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing logic from the Order class by utilizing a separate class or function to manage order status changes instead of incorporating payment functionality directly.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class is currently closed for modification. Any changes in payment processing such as additional checks or different payment methods require altering this class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a strategy pattern where various payment methods can be encapsulated into different classes or functions without modifying the PaymentProcessor itself.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
